nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
High-quality Japanese anime action sequence, hand-drawn 2D cel animation, cinematic anime battle direction, detailed character animation, dramatic lighting, strong sense of speed and impact, dynamic camera movement, clean line art, expressive faces, vivid but controlled colors.

A young female swordswoman with long wavy pink hair fading into light green at the tips, large expressive green eyes, wearing a modified traditional Japanese demon-slayer uniform with a short white haori, wielding an extremely long flexible whip-like Nichirin sword. She fights with an acrobatic, elegant and extremely fast sword style.

Her opponent is a powerful Upper-Rank demon, an inhuman male demon with pale skin, sharp predatory eyes, dark markings across his face and body, wearing elaborate traditional Japanese clothing. He possesses overwhelming physical strength and terrifying speed.

The scene takes place at night in a ruined traditional Japanese town, wooden buildings partially destroyed, broken roof tiles and wooden debris scattered across the street, moonlight cutting through drifting smoke and dust.

The female swordswoman suddenly rushes forward at extreme speed, her long flexible sword whipping through the air in a wide curved arc. The demon blocks the attack with his weapon, producing a powerful shockwave that scatters dust and debris.

She immediately changes direction, gracefully leaps over the demon, twists her body in mid-air, and delivers a rapid series of flowing sword strikes from different angles. Her movements are elegant, elastic and unpredictable, with the flexible blade creating beautiful sweeping arcs through the air.

The demon rapidly dodges and counters with a devastating close-range attack. She narrowly evades it, sliding across the ground, then launches herself forward again. Their weapons collide in the center of the frame with a powerful impact, sparks and fragments of debris flying outward.

Final moment: the swordswoman lands in a low dynamic stance, her long blade extended behind her in a graceful curve, hair and clothing flowing from the momentum. The demon stands several meters away, visibly surprised by her speed. Smoke and dust slowly drift through the moonlight.

Continuous uninterrupted action, coherent body motion, physically believable sword trajectories, consistent character appearance throughout the entire sequence, no sudden character changes, no scene transition, no teleportation, no frozen poses.

Camera: cinematic anime action camera, starts with a medium-wide establishing shot, rapidly pushes toward the fighters, follows the swordswoman during her aerial movement, briefly tracks the flexible sword trajectory, then ends with a dramatic low-angle shot.

Duration: 10 seconds.
Aspect ratio: 16:9.
High motion intensity, fast but readable choreography, strong anticipation and follow-through, cinematic composition.
